title: Finite curve complement and its coefficient-module localization sequence
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme (locally Noetherian and quasi-compact) of topological Krull dimension at most one [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension], and let $U\subseteq X$ be an open subset containing the generic point of every irreducible component [def-weil-irreducible-components, def-sc-generic-point]. Let $u:U\hookrightarrow X$ be its open immersion and let $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ be the reduced induced closed subscheme on $X\setminus U$ [def-weil-open-immersion, lem-weil-pbc-reduced-induced-closed-subscheme]. Then $\dim Z\leq0$, its underlying set is finite, and each of its points is closed in $X$. Let $\Lambda$ be any commutative condensed ring and $F$ any internal module over $\Lambda_X=p_X^*\Lambda$ on $X_{\mathrm{proét}}$ [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring, sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients, sk-def-sfb-module-objects]. With the actual coefficient-module inverse images, direct images and open extension by zero [sk-def-sfb-module-pushforward-pullback, def-sfb-module-open-lower-shriek], the adjunction counit and unit give the short exact sequence $0\to u_!u^*F\to F\to i_*i^*F\to0$, and $u^*i_*i^*F=0$. In particular, if $u^*F$ is lisse [def-sfb-lisse-coefficient-module], this is an extension of a sheaf supported on finitely many closed points by $u_!L$, where $L=u^*F$. Empty complements, the empty scheme, nonreduced and reducible schemes, and $F=0$ are included.

proof.text: Every point w of the closed complement lies in an irreducible component C. Sobriety gives a generic point η of C, and the hypothesis puts η in U. Thus η specializes to w and lies outside the complement. Apply topologicalKrullDim_lt_of_forall_exists_specializes to the closed complement inside X, with d=1 and dim X<2, to get dimension <1, hence at most zero. The closed-immersion embedding identifies Z with the complement. The zero-dimensional closed-subset theorem in the Noetherian T0 space X gives finiteness and closed singletons, and injectivity of i transfers finiteness to Z.

proof.text: Reuse the four proved private module-support lemmas from CondensedOpenClosedRecollement via a proof-only import all: openRestrictionPushforwardZero, openUnitIsIso, moduleCounitOfAbelian and moduleUnitOfAbelian. The first gives vanishing on the complementary open. Apply moduleCounitOfAbelian to abelian_closed_counit for the closed counit. The open unit is invertible by openUnitIsIso. Use profinitePointModuleForgetPullbackIso to compare module and abelian open restrictions; abelian_closed_support and moduleUnitOfAbelian then make the closed unit invertible on every module with zero open restriction.

proof.text: Complementary module restrictions jointly detect zero objects by the supported-unit assertion and the closed direct image of zero. Since both restrictions are exact, apply them to kernels and cokernels to prove joint detection of isomorphisms. The composite of the actual open counit and closed unit is zero by the two adjunctions and disjoint vanishing. Form its short complex. On the closed piece the first term is zero and the second arrow is invertible by the closed triangle identity. On the open piece the last term is zero and the first arrow is invertible by the open triangle identity. The jointly conservative exact-functor criterion reflects short exactness. The previously proved vanishing supplies the last assertion. All arguments include empty schemes and zero modules.
